_comment: Fixed reference scales and constraint bounds for the surrogate optimisation.

objective_reference_scales._comment: SUPERSEDED — no longer read by run.py. Kept here only as a historical record.
objective_reference_scales._source: These were computed from pairwise_outcomes.pkl on ABSOLUTE utility/emissions/net_cost, back when the surrogate's outputs were absolute values. Since utility/emissions/net_cost were changed to BAU-relative deltas (this policy vs. doing nothing), run.py now recomputes reference scales itself from each run's own LHS data (see run.py Step 2 / BAU-RELATIVE OBJECTIVES in its module docstring) — the numbers below are stale for that purpose and are not loaded for it.

bo_weights._comment: Relative importance of each objective in the acquisition function scalarisation. Equal weights = treat a 1-unit-of-range improvement in utility the same as 1-unit-of-range reduction in emissions or cost.
